# Gemini deprecations (a made-up page in the shape of aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations, for tests/ledger-drift.test.ts) A "**deprecation**" is the announcement that we no longer provide support for a model. Once a model is "**shutdown**", it is completely turned off, and the endpoint is no longer available. ## Gemini 9 models {% id="gemini-9-models" %} {% table %} * Model * Release date * Shutdown date * Recommended replacement --- * `gemini-steady` * May 1, 2026 * May 1, 2027 * `gemini-steady-2` --- * `gemini-moved` * February 26, 2026 * December 18, 2026 * `gemini-moved-2` --- * `gemini-withdrawn` * March 11, 2026 * No shutdown date announced * `gemini-withdrawn-2` --- * `gemini-stitch-a` * June 1, 2026 * June 1, 2027 * `gemini-stitch-a-2` --- * `gemini-stitch-b` * July 1, 2026 * July 1, 2027 * `gemini-stitch-b-2` {% /table %} ### Deprecated models (none on this made-up page; the heading is part of the shape the check expects of the page, 0.4.3 R3)
